messages:
Rina: Quick follow-up from the RFC: finalized canary/rollback playbook for mixed quant rollouts (FP8/INT8/4bit). Posting proposed ops steps so we can lock it down.
Diego: Awesome. High level?
Rina: Canary = 1% steady sample, shadowing at 3% for fidelity. Minimum observation window = 45 minutes or 3000 requests, whichever first. Use ensemble-quality signal (deg_score + token_coherence + p95 latency).
Priya: What are the exact triggers for automated action?
Rina: Auto actions:
- Immediate full rollback if p99 latency increases by >200ms OR error rate >0.8% (catastrophic).
- Staged mitigation for quality regressions: if ensemble delta > 1.5% absolute OR SNR_drop > 3 dB across the window -> reduce sample by half and alert. If still above thresholds after 20m, escalate to full rollback.
Kai: I like staged. Add bootstrapped CI on deg_score so we don't act on noise.
Priya: Agree. Also suggest a short manual gating step for customer-facing endpoints: if a customer has >0.5% traffic contribution, require manual signoff before full rollout to them.
Diego: How are we computing SNR here? We need a reproducible definition in the playbook.
Rina: SNR = 10 * log10(Var(signal)/Var(noise)) where signal = baseline embeddings on calibration set, noise = difference between quantized outputs and baseline on the same set. We store per-model baseline stats in the eval-store.
Priya: Can we add stochastic rounding as an experiment flag? Sometimes it helps fp8 stability. Gate behind an infra flag and separate shadowing.
Kai: Yes. We'll add a runtime flag: quant.stochastic_rounding=true/false. Shadow it at 1% when toggled.
Rina: Telemetry: must tag every request with quant_profile and quant_flags, e.g. headers: "X-Quant-Profile: fp8-a" and "X-Quant-Flags: stochastic_rounding". Trace example: `trace.quant.profile=fp8-a;trace.quant.flags=stochastic_rounding`. Logs should include deg_score and snr_db.
Diego: Example log line?
Rina: Example:
```json
{"timestamp":"...","req_id":"r-42","quant_profile":"fp8-a","flags":"stochastic_rounding","deg_score":0.009,"snr_db":2.7}
```
Priya: Add a lint check on profile changes: PRs that modify quant profiles must include a canary block in the model manifest and a stress-test report. Fail CI if missing.
Kai: Ops-wise: add a canary-bot action that will automatically create an incident runbook entry when the staged mitigation triggers and post steps to reduce sample + who to ping.
canary-bot: canary started: model=redwood-mosaic-hybrid-fp8 v=3 sample=1% shadow=3%
Diego: Nice. One more: fallback composition. If we rollback FP8 path, should we automatically switch to INT8 or revert to float?
Rina: Prefer: fallback order = per-tenant override -> INT8 compatible profile -> baseline float 32. We try the next cheaper option first (INT8) to preserve cost gains. Documented in playbook.
Priya: Make sure per-tenant overrides are honored via routing tags; platform should never silently expose a downgraded model to a paying customer.
Kai: We'll extend routing to carry tenant_override tags and a strict_match option.
Rina: I'll open 3 PRs: 1) playbook doc + YAML canary schema, 2) CI lint rule, 3) infra flag + telemetry labels. Will post links here. Thanks everyone.
Diego: :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks, this covers the gaps I wanted.
Rina: Will follow up with runbook snippets and a short onboarding doc for SREs.
